params.body:
Outside the opening hours, a visit is by appointment. That belongs under all the hours, not on one line, so the settings get one optional text for it.

## What changes

- `siteSettings` gets **`hoursNote`** (title *Tekst onder de openingsuren*, localeString, optional). The site shows it under the opening hours, for example "Daarbuiten op afspraak". Empty: nothing is shown.
- `CONTRACT.md` and `tests/contract.test.ts` follow.

The site side is ShaneDeconinck/schoutteet, branch `workbench/hours-extra-line`.

## After merge

Deploy the Studio. Then, under *Instellingen en openingsuren*:
- Add Saturday as a plain line, 07:30 to 12:00, without *Extra tekst*.
- Fill *Tekst onder de openingsuren*: nl "Daarbuiten op afspraak", en "Otherwise by appointment", fr "Sinon sur rendez-vous", de "Sonst nach Vereinbarung", es "Otras horas con cita previa".
- Publish.

## Checks

- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean
- `npx vitest run`: 13 passed
- `npx eslint schemaTypes tests`: clean
- `npx sanity build`: built
params.title: Settings: optional text under all the opening hours
